sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.snippet: The Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 is a state-of-the-art multilingual instruct language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. Unlike the base Qwen3-4B, this variant has only instruct training without thinking mode support. This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 found here.
